entities.summary: The Jiji line is a branch line of the Taiwan Railway, located in Changhua and Nantou counties in Taiwan. It is a narrow-gauge railway, and the longest branch line in Taiwan. The line is operated as a heritage railway, catering to tourists wanting to visit this part of central Taiwan.
